card: Square Feed images and 9:16 Reels clips from one photo.

faq.q: Can I make a Facebook ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, describe your product moment and choose a square image or Reels-style clip. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: Can I make ads for the Feed, Reels and Stories?
faq.a: Make a square still for the Feed, or a 9:16 clip for Reels and Stories. Choose the file for the format you plan to run.

faq.q: Do I need to book a Facebook creator or studio?
faq.a: No. Start from your own product photo, so there is no creator booking, studio day or footage queue.

faq.q: Can I make several Facebook ad versions?
faq.a: Yes. Run another job from the same photo with a different scene or opening, without arranging another shoot.

faq.q: Where do I add the headline and price?
faq.a: Add the primary text, headline, price and call to action in Ads Manager after download, where you can change them for each audience.

faq.q: Does the download include sound or captions?
faq.a: No. Add sound and caption text in Ads Manager or an editor after you download the file.

faq.q: What photo should I upload for a Facebook ad?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product and leaves a little space around it for Meta crops and controls.

faq.q: Do I need to label a Facebook ad as AI-made?
faq.a: Follow Meta's current AI-label and ad-review prompts in Ads Manager for the market where you will run the ad.
